blocks.text: Architecting a Unified CISO Dashboard for a Global ER&D Leader
Research & Development
Client
A global leader in engineering and R&D services with over seventeen-thousand IT users.
Ambition
To consolidate data from disparate security solutions into a single, intelligent, and actionable CISO dashboard to monitor and manage their global security posture in real time.
Outcome
Architected and deployed a rich, ML-infused dashboard that provided a unified view of their entire threat landscape, enabling them to identify risks and remediate threats in real time.
The Ambition
A global leader in engineering and R&D services with over seventeen-thousand IT users.
The Challenge

Their security solutions were all operating in silos. This made it impossible to get a consolidated view of their threat environment. They needed a way to ingest data from all these sources, correlate it, and present it in a way that was not just informative but actionable. The dashboard needed to be accessible anytime, anywhere, including on mobile devices.
The Architectural Blueprint

The client's ambition was to operate a truly proactive, data-driven security organization. They needed to move from a siloed view of security to a holistic one, providing their information security team and C-suite with a single source of truth to monitor their posture, identify risks, and make faster, more informed decisions.
Ambition, Realized

The CISO dashboard transformed their security operations. They now have a complete, real-time solution to monitor, trace, and remediate any security incident anywhere in the world, right from their smartphones. The integration of their siloed solutions provides a powerful, all-round view of their threat environment. The use of AI and ML features augments their human monitoring, sharply reducing the possibility of missing small but vital security signals that could have been costly lapses.
Key Business Impact
Created a Unified, Single-Pane-of-Glass View of Security
Enabled Real-Time Threat Monitoring & Remediation
Augmented Human Analysis with AI & ML Insights
Leveraged Existing Security Investments to Reduce Costs
Back to Happy Customer Back to Happy Customer
